blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present an improvement on previous spacecraft pose estimation architectures that results in the lowest published mean rotation errors we know of on the SPEED+ lightbox and sunlamp test sets for a known, non-cooperative spacecraft. By using a previously established heatmap-based pose estimation architecture and adapting a large self-supervised ViT foundation model (DINOv3) in place of the smaller convolutional and ViT encoders of previous work, we show that pose estimation accuracy improves from 300M to 840M parameters with no saturation yet observed. We also evaluate our 840M model on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB, measuring single-pass network inference at 133.8 ms per crop with a board draw of 32.0 W. These measurements demonstrate embedded inference feasibility on a processor family with orbital flight heritage. Our resulting model outperforms previous models across lightbox and sunlamp domains while training only on synthetic data. Our best model, using DINOv3 840M adapted with LoRA as the encoder (rank 64, three-seed ensemble with four-rotation test-time augmentation), results in 1.56 ∘ mean rotation error on sunlamp and 1.17 ∘ on lightbox, compared to the previous best mean rotation errors we know of on these test sets, 2.66 ∘ and 1.75 ∘ by EagerNet.
blocks.zh: 我们对以前的航天器作了改进,提出了各种估计结构,在SPEED+灯盒和对一个已知的、不合作的航天器的日照试验装置上,出现了我们所知的最低公布的平均旋转误差。 通过使用先前建立的基于热映射的配置估计架构,并调整一个大型的自控ViT基础模型(DINOv3),以取代之前作品的较小的演化和ViT编码器,我们显示,这种配置使估计精度从300M提高到840M参数,但尚未观察到饱和度. 我们还在Jetson Orin NX 16GB上评价我们的840M模型,测量单路网推论为每条作物133.8毫秒,板画为32.0瓦. 这些测量表明,对于具有轨道飞行遗产的处理器家族来说,嵌入式推论是可行的。 我们产生的模型超越了以前的模型 跨越灯盒和阳光灯域,而只培训合成数据。 我们的最佳模式是使用与LORA相适应的DINov3 840M作为编码器(排名64,三种子合唱,四轮旋转测试时间加固),结果在日光灯上出现1.56××的旋转误差,在灯盒上出现1.17×××的旋转误差,相比之下我们在这些测试机上已知的以往最佳平均误差,2.66×××和1.75××××的EagerNet.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: In the coming years the number of missions that require a rendezvous between two craft in orbit will likely increase considerably [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . In the best cases, the target craft in question will be equipped with modern docking features that reduce the risk and complexity of the maneuver. Features like IR dots around docking ports and shared telemetry over stable connections between craft make pose estimation, the problem of an approaching craft knowing the target’s 6D pose (relative position and orientation), straightforward. However, many missions will need to be conducted that are not so easy. Targets that are legacy, natural (such as asteroids), broken, or otherwise uncooperative will nonetheless need to be approached and therefore their 6D pose will need to be accurately ascertained without pre-planned cooperative systems assisting. 1 1 1 Here, non-cooperative refers to the absence of assistance from the target spacecraft; our method still assumes that its geometry and the 3D locations of the selected keypoints are known.
blocks.zh: 在今后几年中,需要在轨道上的两艘飞船之间汇合的飞行任务数目可能大大增加[1、2、3]。 在最好的情况下,有关目标船将配备现代对接功能,以减少操作的风险和复杂性。 类似IR点在对接端口周围的特征, 然而,许多任务需要开展,但并非那么容易。 遗留、自然(如小行星)、破裂或以其他方式不合作的目标仍需处理,因此,在事先计划的合作系统不提供协助的情况下,必须准确确定它们的6D姿态。 页:1 1 这里,不合作是指目标航天器没有援助;我们的方法仍然假定其几何和选定关键点的3D位置是已知的.

blocks.en: An additional layer of difficulty is added when considering the constraints imposed by the particular environment the missions will take place in and the material limits of the craft that will be engaging in them. Imagery taken of the target craft is subject to harsh sun lighting that, without the aid of atmospheric diffusion, casts pitch black shadows and overexposes metallic surfaces in direct light. Earth albedo provides some soft fill illumination but cannot be relied upon. Active sensors that would alleviate these visual difficulties somewhat, such as LiDAR, add mass, power draw, and system complexity (the RVS 3000-3D rendezvous LiDAR used for the MEV-1 docking, for example, is specified at 12.4–15.3 kg and roughly 71 W nominal power [ 4 ] ). While monocular pose estimation also incurs computational and energy costs, most methods can run on an embedded GPU without requiring a custom processor designed specifically for pose estimation.
blocks.zh: 在考虑特定环境造成的限制时,将增加一个层次的困难,因为特派团将执行这些任务,而且从事这些任务的船只的物质限制。 拍摄目标飞行器的图像受到严酷的阳光照射,如果没有大气扩散的帮助,就会直接投射黑阴影和过度暴露金属表面。 地球反照率提供了一些软填充照明,但不能依赖。 能够在一定程度上缓解这些视觉困难的主动传感器,如LiDAR,增加了质量,功率绘图和系统复杂性(例如,用于MEV-1对接的RVS 3000-3D会合LiDAR在12.4-15.3千克和大约71W标称功率[4]). 虽然单体的构型估计也会产生计算和能量成本,但大多数方法可以在嵌入式GPU上运行,而不需要专门设计用于构型估计的自定义处理器.

blocks.en: For these reasons, pose estimation using greyscale monocular imagery has been an object of research interest [ 5 ] . Given the unique difficulty of obtaining real training imagery, the problem of solving pose estimation has gone hand in hand with the problem of bridging the gap between simulated and real training data. SPEED+ was developed as a benchmark by Park et al. [ 5 ] , a collaboration between Stanford’s Space Rendezvous Laboratory (SLAB) and ESA’s Advanced Concepts Team, and followed by a competition in 2021–2022, the Satellite Pose Estimation Competition (SPEC2021), hosted on ESA’s Kelvins platform [ 6 ] . The SPEED+ dataset includes both simulated images of a satellite ‘Tango’ along with real images taken of a physical Tango model staged to simulate harsh direct sun (‘sunlamp’) as well as earth albedo (‘lightbox’). The real imagery comprises 9,531 hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test images of the mockup in Stanford’s TRON facility alongside roughly 60,000 synthetic images (training and validation), examples of which are shown in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 由于这些原因,使用灰度单体图像进行估计一直是研究感兴趣的对象[5]。 鉴于获取真实培训图像的独特困难,解决假想估计问题与弥合模拟培训数据与真实培训数据之间的差距问题同时存在。 SPEED+是Park等人作为基准制定的。 [5],斯坦福的空间汇兑实验室(SLAB)与欧空局高级概念小组之间的合作,随后于2021-2022年在欧空局开尔文斯平台上举办了卫星松皮估计竞赛(SPEC2021)。 SPEED+数据集既包括卫星 " 坦戈 " 的模拟图像,也包括为模拟严酷直阳( " 太阳标本 " )而制作的物理探戈模型的真实图像以及地球反照率( " 灯盒 " )。 真实图像包括9,531幅斯坦福TRON设施模拟的硬件模拟图像(HIL)以及大约6万幅合成图像(培训和验证),图1显示了其中的例子。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Example SPEED+ imagery: synthetic training render (left), lightbox HIL test image (center), sunlamp HIL test image (right). Imagery from SPEED+ [ 5 ] , CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
blocks.zh: 图1:实例 SPEED+图像:合成训练渲染(左),灯盒 HIL测试图像(中),阳光灯 HIL测试图像(右). 图片来自SPEED+[5],CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

blocks.en: Significant progress has been made in recent years in solving both the sim to real gap in this domain as well as the central problem of pose estimation itself. The competition was won with mean rotation errors of 2.73 ∘ on sunlamp (team lava1302) and 3.19 ∘ on lightbox (team TangoUnchained) [ 6 ] , though the top entrants all used some of the real imagery during training. The competition postmortem further improved on the competition results with entrants such as FA-VAE [ 7 ] and the semi-supervised domain adaptation of Chen et al. [ 8 ] . In more recent years, further refinements have pushed the edge further while showing that state of the art results are possible without ever using non-simulated data in training. Impressive results include those of Ulmer et al.’s EagerNet [ 9 ] whose technique also markedly improves on many previous methods by producing state of the art results while requiring only an approximate 3D model of the target. Park and D’Amico, the team behind SPNv3 [ 10 ] , showed that it was possible to produce competitive results on a model of only 22.7M parameters (compared to EagerNet’s approximately 88.6M-parameter backbone). Concurrently with our research, Bergia et al. [ 11 ] also implemented a DINOv3 backbone with a heatmap head, obtaining their best result by self-training on unlabeled HIL imagery with DINOv3-L at 224 × 224 224\times 224 input. Our contribution uses low-rank adapters at 448 × 448 448\times 448 input, scales to the 840M encoder, and includes controls that isolate the source of the gains to encoder scale and adaptation. On the same DINOv3-L encoder, our single-pass synthetic-only model reaches 1.90 ∘ / 2.26 ∘ (lightbox / sunlamp) against their 3.27 ∘ / 4.06 ∘ , a 42% / 44% reduction in mean rotation error, and our best configuration reaches 1.17 ∘ / 1.56 ∘ against their self-trained 2.57 ∘ / 3.25 ∘ . Table I summarizes these prior results. Recent direct-regression approaches trained on SPEED+ synthetic imagery, such as FastPose-ViT [ 12 ] , PAID-ViT [ 13 ] , and Cov2Pose [ 14 ] , report mean rotation errors above 11 ∘ on the HIL domains and are not included in Table I . Recent keypoint-based approaches include mask-guided attention and adaptive keypoint suppression by Peng et al. [ 15 ] and a depth-aware keypoint loss by Yang et al. [ 16 ] ; neither study reports separate results on the full SPEED+ lightbox and sunlamp test sets.
blocks.zh: 近年来,在解决该领域的成败差距和提出估算本身的核心问题方面取得了重大进展。 比赛以日照(Team lava1302)的2.73 QQ和灯盒(team TangoUnchained)的3.19 QQ的中间旋转误差获胜,不过顶尖入场者在训练时都使用了一些真实的图像. 比赛结束后,与FA-VAE[7]等进入者的竞争结果和陈等的半监督域适应性进一步提高. [8]. 近年来,进一步的改进进一步推进了边缘,同时表明在培训中不使用非模拟数据就有可能取得最新技术成果。 令人印象深刻的成果包括Ulmer等人的EagerNet[9],其技术也明显改进了以前的许多方法,产生最新技术结果,同时只需要一个大致的3D目标模型。 SPNv3 [10] 背后的团队Park和D ' Amico显示,在只有22.7M参数的模型上(与EagerNet的大约88.6M参数主干线相比)可以产生竞争结果。 与我们的研究同时发生的还有Bergia等人. [11] 还采用了一个带有热映射头的DINOv3主干线,通过在无标签的HIL图像上进行自我训练,以224×224/224\times 224输入的方式获得了最佳效果. 我们的贡献使用448×448 448\times448输入的低档适配器,比例尺为840M编码器,包括将收益源隔离为编码尺度和适应的控制. 在同一DINOv3-L编码器上,我们的单通道合成唯一型号达到1.90 ∘ / 2.26 ∘(灯盒 / sunlamp),与他们的3.27 ∘ / 4.06 ∘ ,平均旋转误差减少42% / 44 %,我们的最佳配置达到1.17 ∘ / 1.56 ∘,与他们自训练的2.57 ∘ / 3.25 ∘ . 图表 我总结了这些先前的结果。 最近接受过SPEED+合成图像培训的直接回归方法,如FastPose-ViT [12],PAID-ViT [13],以及Cov2Pose [14],在HIL域上报告高于11Q的旋转误差,不列入表一. 最近基于关键点的方法包括彭等人的面具引导关注和适应性关键点抑制[15],以及杨等人的深度意识关键点丢失. [16];两个研究都没有报告整个SPEED+灯盒和日照测试集的单独结果.

Values are reported under each source’s own training and crop/detection protocol and are not a controlled comparison under one common pipeline. Our rotation-error values in Table II are unthresholded means; the prior values in this table are reproduced as reported and may apply the HIL precision floor.

blocks.en: Previous research has generally used small models compared to the large ViT foundation models increasingly used in other applications. Some models, such as SPNv3, were specifically designed around operating on limited compute. In the coming years, though, it is likely that onboard compute resources will become more common and less cost prohibitive [ 18 ] . We set out to answer whether scaling improves pose estimation and to measure the computational cost of the resulting model on embedded hardware. Our research shows that there is indeed significant headroom and that previous architectures, when adapted to use cutting edge SSL vision foundation models, produce state of the art mean rotation errors on the SPEED+ lightbox and sunlamp test sets that improve on all previously published results we know of for those domains.
blocks.zh: 以往的研究一般使用小型模型,而其他应用中越来越多地使用大型ViT基模型. 一些型号,如SPNv3,是围绕有限计算运行而专门设计的. 然而,在今后几年中,机上计算资源很可能变得更为普遍,费用也更低。 我们着手回答缩放改进是否构成估计,并衡量所形成的模型在嵌入式硬件上的计算成本。 我们的研究表明,确实有重要的前厅,以前的建筑,在适应于使用尖端SSL视觉基础模型时,在SPEED+灯盒和日光灯测试集上产生最先进的旋转误差,从而改进了我们已知的关于这些领域的所有先前公布的结果。

blocks.en: II Method
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en: We began by implementing the SPNv3 architecture described by Park and D’Amico in “Bridging the Domain Gap for Flight-Ready Spaceborne Vision” [ 10 ] . SPNv3 is a three stage architecture involving: 1. A bounding box detection algorithm that crops the high resolution input image to produce a smaller image of the target object suitable to be fed into the subsequent vision model. 2. Detection of K K predefined keypoints on the image of the target 3. A pose solution solver that takes the 2D keypoint locations and produces a 6D pose solution using the well-established Perspective-n-Point (PnP) family of solvers [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们首先采用了Park和D ' Amico在 " 为飞行后空载视野开拓领域 " 中描述的SPNv3架构。 SPNv3是一个三级建筑,涉及: 1. 边框检测算法,将高分辨率输入图像收割,生成一个适合输入后续视觉模型的目标物体的较小图像。 2. 探测目标图像上的 K K 预定义键点 3. 采用2D键点位置并产生6D位点解析器的位点解析器,使用既定的Pincept-n-Point(PnP)解析器家族[19].

blocks.en: A bounding box detection algorithm that crops the high resolution input image to produce a smaller image of the target object suitable to be fed into the subsequent vision model.
blocks.zh: 一个边框检测算法,将高分辨率的输入图像收成,生成一个适合输入后续视觉模型的目标对象的较小图像.

blocks.en: Detection of K K predefined keypoints on the image of the target
blocks.zh: 检测目标图像上的 K K 预定义键位

blocks.en: A pose solution solver that takes the 2D keypoint locations and produces a 6D pose solution using the well-established Perspective-n-Point (PnP) family of solvers [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 一个位式解析器,它使用2D键点位置,并使用已确立的Purview-n-Point(PnP)解析器家族[19] 生成一个6D位式解析器.

blocks.en: For our purposes, we can more or less treat steps 1 and 3 of this architecture as fixed. Following SPNv3, we use ground-truth-derived crops in place of a bounding box detection algorithm for stage 1 so that our comparison isolates the keypoint detection task central to stage 2. 2 2 2 Our SPEED+ results therefore evaluate the keypoint-and-PnP stage given a ground-truth-derived crop, the same protocol as SPNv3. Comparisons with methods that include their own detector, such as EagerNet and the SPEC2021 entries, are not under an identical protocol. The pose solution solving math in step 3 is already well established. 3 3 3 During training, crops are randomly enlarged and shifted to build robustness against imperfect bounding boxes, as in SPNv3. Remaining error in pose solutions for this architecture stem from inaccuracies in placing keypoints in stage 2.
blocks.zh: 为了我们的目的,我们可以或多或少地将这一架构的第一步和第三步视为固定的. 继SPNv3之后,我们用地面真假的作物来代替第1阶段的边框检测算法,这样我们的比较就可以分离出第2阶段的核心关键点检测任务 2 2 2 我们的SPEED+结果 因此,在地面真假的作物下,评价关键点和PnP阶段,与SPNv3的相同协议. 与包括自己探测器的方法的比较,如EagerNet和SPEC2021条目,并不在一个相同的协议下. 解决第3步数学的姿势解决方案已经确立。 3 3 3 在训练期间,作物随机扩大,并转向建立坚固性,以对抗不完善的边框,如SPNv3中. 提出这一架构的解决方案仍有错误,原因是将关键点放在第2阶段有不准确之处。

blocks.en: In the case of SPNv3, stage 2 uses a neural net feeding heads that output K K heatmaps for the keypoints ( K = 11 K=11 for Tango). SPNv3 trained ViTPose, originally proposed by Xu et al. [ 20 ] , for this purpose. For our implementation, we decided to tune DINOv3 [ 21 ] , a self-supervised vision foundation model by Meta AI, in place of ViTPose’s ViT-S backbone. We trained the 300M variant using both LoRA [ 22 ] and DoRA [ 23 ] , and the 840M variant using LoRA, across only synthetic imagery. As with previous implementations, we found that random seeding multiple models and predicting via consensus between an ensemble of 3 produced superior results for the 300M model. For the rank-64 840M model, the three independently trained models with four-rotation test-time augmentation (the crop rotated by 0 ∘ , 90 ∘ , 180 ∘ , and 270 ∘ , with the back-rotated heatmaps averaged using each view’s peak confidence as its weight) gave mean rotation errors of 1.19–1.20 ∘ on lightbox and 1.49–1.79 ∘ on sunlamp. Combining the three models with the same augmentation gave 1.17 ∘ and 1.56 ∘ , respectively. We report the single-model and ensemble configurations separately because they require four and twelve network passes per frame.
blocks.zh: 在SPNv3中,第2阶段使用神经网供餐头,为键点输出K K热映射(K=11 K=11 for Tango). SPNv3训练ViTPose,最初由徐等人提出. [20],为此. 由Meta AI自导自演的视觉基础模型, 我们使用LORA[22]和DORA[23]两种方法培训了300M变体,使用LORA的840M变体,只跨越合成图像. 与以往的实施一样,我们发现,随机播种多种模型和通过3集的共识预测,为300M模型产生了优异的结果. 对于等级-64 840M型号,三个经过独立训练的型号有四轮旋转测试时间增殖(作物旋转0×××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××年××月××日××××日×××××××××××年×××月××××日××日××××××××××××××日××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××年×月×日××日××××××××××××××××××××日××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××年××××××××××××××××××××××××××× 将三种型号与相同的增量组合,分别给出了1.17 ∘和1.56 ∘. 我们分别报告单型和综艺的配置,因为它们每帧需要4个和12个网络通行证.

blocks.en: Our training, as mentioned, was purely on the official synthetic training split of SPEED+ (approximately 48,000 renders), with the 11,994-image synthetic validation split held out. Across all rank-16 training runs our configuration was held constant with the exception of the encoder itself and per-encoder input normalization matched to the encoder’s specific pre-training statistics. The rank-64 runs raise the adapter rank from 16 to 64 (with LoRA scaling α / r \alpha/r of 2 instead of 1), and the rank-64 840M runs additionally lower the learning rate to 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} for training stability. Network inputs were always the same 448 × 448 448\times 448 crops. The heatmap head was trained from scratch in every run (two transposed-convolution upsampling blocks and a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution producing 112 × 112 112\times 112 heatmaps, trained with a mean-squared-error loss against Gaussian targets). The original optimization schedule used AdamW with learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 30 epochs at batch size 32, and one warmup epoch followed by cosine decay; the rank-64 840M runs retain this schedule with the lower learning rate stated above. Thanks to modern fine-tuning methods such as LoRA and DoRA we were able to achieve our results while adding trainable parameters equivalent to roughly 0.5–3% of total encoder weights in each tuning run, with the original encoder weights remaining frozen; adapters are placed on the query/key/value and output projections of every attention block. Since SPEED+ does not provide a real-image validation split, we follow the standards set in prior work and use the lightbox and sunlamp sets both to compare settings and to choose inference-time settings. No real images were used for training. As an additional check on our results, we used only the even-numbered frames of each real set to choose the inference-time settings and then scored the odd-numbered frames with the configuration selected that way, a single model with four-rotation test-time augmentation. This resulted in mean rotation errors of 1.22 ∘ on lightbox and 1.52 ∘ on sunlamp, consistent with the full-set results.

blocks.en: We conducted a number of control runs in an effort to confirm the gains we achieved were due to tuning a larger encoder and not a difference in our architecture or improvements generally in base encoders (Table III ):
blocks.zh: 我们进行了多次控制运行,以确认我们之所以取得这些成就,是因为调整了一个更大的编码器,而不是我们的架构或基本编码器的改进(表三):

blocks.en: 1. Since we followed SPNv3 closely architecturally, we conducted our own training run using a similar baseline encoder (22M DeiT3 [ 24 ] ViT-S) and obtained results in the same range. 2. To test whether modern ViT encoders can support pose estimation without fine tuning, we attempted to train only the head while using DINOv3 and SigLIP2-L [ 25 ] as encoders in their own respective runs. Each failed to produce usable results when the encoder was frozen for training (DINOv3: 18% / 29% catastrophic flips on lightbox / sunlamp; SigLIP2-L: 54% / 70%). 3. EUPE-S [ 26 ] , a modern 22M parameter encoder, was trained with LoRA to test whether modern encoders still produced similar results to similarly sized encoders used in previous models like SPNv3. EUPE-S with LoRA actually ended up producing significantly worse results compared to our fully trained 22M DeiT3 [ 24 ] ViT-S baseline, showing that using modern encoders and fine-tuning techniques alone does not improve on previous results. 4. We trained SigLIP2-L using LoRA to confirm that other modern large pretrained ViT models show similar improvements with tuning and that our results are not unique to DINOv3’s architecture. DINOv3 300M does seem to be a better model for this application, as SigLIP2-L (316M) remained 18–23% behind DINOv3-L (303M) with LoRA (1.90 ∘ / 2.26 ∘ vs 2.47 ∘ / 2.74 ∘ ).

blocks.en: IV Hardware Testing
blocks.zh: 四 硬件测试

blocks.en: While not a primary focus of this paper, we did want to benchmark the performance of our system on hardware that has already flown real missions as a preliminary test to see if computation of this size is viable. This is especially important since many past approaches, including the SPNv3 approach on which we based our model, cite computation constraints as a reason for opting for a smaller model.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们不是本文的主要重点,但我们确实希望以已经执行过实际飞行任务的硬件作为我们系统业绩的基准,作为初步测试,看看这种规模的计算是否可行。 这一点特别重要,因为过去的许多办法,包括我们作为模型基础的SPNv3办法,都以计算方面的限制因素作为选择较小模型的理由。

blocks.en: Bergia et al. [ 11 ] also evaluated DINOv3-L on a Jetson Orin NX at 224 × 224 224\times 224 input using TensorRT FP16. Our measurements characterize the larger 840M model at 448 × 448 448\times 448 input, including measured board power.
blocks.zh: Bergia等人[11]还利用TensorRT FP16对Jetson Orin NX上的DINov3-L进行了224×224\times 224输入评价. 我们的测量特征是更大的840M模型在448×448 448\times 448输入,包括测量板功率.

blocks.en: We chose to test on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16GB, a 70 × 45 70\times 45 mm system-on-module with a 1,792-core Ampere GPU, 16 GB of shared memory, and a configurable 10–40 W power envelope [ 27 ] from a module family flown in 2026 on Aethero’s Phobos [ 28 ] and EDGX’s STERNA [ 29 ] payloads. Our preliminary findings are positive, showing that our 840M model is able to run at 133.8 ms per single network pass at 32.0 W measured board draw, and 419.8 ms at 10.8 W; four-view batches take 501.9 ms and 1.63 s at those respective operating points.
blocks.zh: 我们选择在一个NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16GB、一个70×45 70\时的45毫米系统模块上测试,该模块有一个1,792核心的安佩尔GPU,16GB共享内存,以及一个2026年在Aethero的Phobos [28] 和EDGQs STERNA [29]有效载荷上飞行的一个模块家庭的可配置的10–40W动力包[27]。 我们的初步调查结果是积极的,表明我们的840M型号能够以每条网络133.8毫秒的速度运行在32.0度. W测量板抽取,10.8W时为419.8ms;四视分批在相应操作点为501.9ms和1.63s.

blocks.en: It should be noted that the Orin, while small enough to be suitable for some missions, is a heavier module, in power and thermal terms, than is often needed or flown in many cases (its rated envelope is 10–40 W, and we measured 10.8–32 W of total board draw). Additionally, we have not tested the capabilities of the chip under radiation or in a flight-representative thermal environment. Given these limitations, these results are informative for assessing viability in cases where a mission is already being flown with sufficient compute on board. More testing is needed for true flight-ready assessment and for viability on smaller, more energy-constrained craft.
blocks.zh: 应当指出,奥林号虽然小到足以适合某些任务,但从动力和热力角度来说,是比经常需要的或飞行的更重的舱(其额定信封为10-40 W,我们测得的机板总图纸为10.8-32 W)。 此外,我们还没有在辐射下或在具有飞行代表性的热环境中测试芯片的能力。 鉴于这些局限性,这些结果有助于评估在飞行中已经有足够的计算任务的情况下的可行性。 需要进行更多的测试,以便进行真正的飞行准备状态评估,以及使更小型、更受能源限制的飞行器具有可行性。

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Percent of the retained real frames the model incorrectly flipped, at various rates of least-confident frame abstention, for the 300M DINOv3-L + LoRA model.
blocks.zh: 图3:为300M DINov3-L + LORA型号,所保留的真帧中,有百分比的模型不正确翻转,以各种最不自信的帧弃权率.

blocks.en: Our rank-16 300M model in a single pass (1.90 ∘ lightbox / 2.26 ∘ sunlamp) achieves lower mean rotation errors than every previously published single-pass model result we know of on the full lightbox and sunlamp test sets (best prior single model, SPNv3-B: 2.18 ∘ / 3.61 ∘ ), and with 4-rotation test-time augmentation (1.72 ∘ / 2.01 ∘ ) it also exceeds the next best result, EagerNet, with four network passes, matching EagerNet’s rotation count (1.75 ∘ / 2.66 ∘ ). Our rank-16 840M model in a single pass (1.34 ∘ / 1.84 ∘ ) exceeds every rank-16 multi-pass configuration of the 300M model and all previously published mean rotation-error results we know of on the full lightbox and sunlamp test sets, with or without ensemble or test-time augmentation (Table II ).
blocks.zh: 我们的军衔16300 M型在单传(1.90 ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ 2.26 ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ) ) ) ) ) ∘ ) ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ ∘ 我们的军衔16 840M型号单传(1.34 ∘ / 1.84 ∘ ∘ )超过了300M型的每架军衔16次多传配置,以及所有先前公布的在全灯盒和日照测试机组上,无论有无综艺或测试时间的增强,我们都知道的平均旋转-误差结果(表二).

blocks.en: With rank-64 adaptation, the 840M three-seed ensemble and four-rotation test-time augmentation gives 1.17 ∘ mean rotation error on lightbox and 1.56 ∘ on sunlamp, with catastrophic-flip rates of 0.10% and 0.21% and pose scores of 0.0273 and 0.0383, respectively. These results are computed over the full test sets without abstention. This configuration uses twelve network passes per frame; the Jetson measurements separately characterize one-pass and four-pass inference for a single model.
blocks.zh: 随着等级-64的调整,840M三种子综艺和四轮旋转测试时间的增强给灯盒1.17 QQ平均旋转误差和日照1.56 QQ,灾难性滑翔率分别为0.10%和0.21%,并分别以0.0273和0.0383的成绩表示. 这些结果在全部测试中进行计算,没有弃权。 这种配置采用每帧12个网络通道;Jetson测量法将单路通道和四路通道推论分别定性为单路模式.

blocks.en: For the rank-64 840M ensemble with four-rotation test-time augmentation, median translation error is 2.5 cm on lightbox and 3.4 cm on sunlamp, at target distances of 2.5–9.6 m. The ensemble fails on 13 of the 9,531 real frames, and one frame in each domain fails for every training seed. These are often near-black or glare-saturated (Fig. 2 ). Many of these failures are flips that result in an extreme incorrect pose estimation in excess of 30 degrees. These flips often happen when the model mirrors the locations of the keypoints on the largely symmetric Tango satellite. A range check on the solved distance would remove the ‡ cases in Table II , but it catches only one flip per domain while the other flips solve to a plausible distance.
blocks.zh: 对于等级为64 840M的组合,带有四轮旋转测试时间加固,中间翻译误差为灯箱2.5厘米,日照3.4厘米,目标距离为2.5–9.6米. 综艺在9,531个真帧中13个失败,每个域中有一个框架每个训练种子失败. 这些常为近黑或闪光饱和(图2). 这些失败中有许多是翻转的,导致极不正确的姿势估计超过30度. 这些翻转经常发生,当模型在大体对称的Tango卫星上映射关键点的位置时. 对解开的距离进行范围检查可以删除表II中的QQ大小写,但每个域只抓一个翻转,而另一个翻转的翻转则能解决一个合理的距离.

blocks.en: For the original rank-16 single-pass models, we observed that the model’s confidence was low in most cases when catastrophic flips occurred. The 300M model showed a median per-frame confidence (the mean of its K K per-keypoint heatmap peak values) of 0.90 on correct frames vs 0.39 on flipped frames in the lightbox domain and 0.88 vs 0.41 in the sunlamp domain; the 840M model gives 0.92 vs 0.31 and 0.91 vs 0.39 on the respective domains. When broken down by degrees of error with and without flips included, our 300M model has a mean rotation error of 1.90 ∘ / 2.26 ∘ (lightbox / sunlamp) over all frames but 1.51 ∘ / 1.82 ∘ over the non-flipped frames alone; the 840M model 1.34 ∘ / 1.84 ∘ versus 1.23 ∘ / 1.52 ∘ . As can be seen in Fig. 3 , the model generally gives much lower confidence to flipped predictions. By retrospectively withholding the 2% least-confident frames, the 300M model’s flip rate falls from 0.43% / 0.47% to 0.09% / 0.07% and its mean rotation error to 1.46 ∘ / 1.81 ∘ . It is possible to remove every flip in both real domains by withholding 10% of frames which would lower the mean error to 1.24 ∘ / 1.62 ∘ ; the 840M model needs only 2% withheld to reach zero flips in both domains (from 0.13% / 0.21%, against 1.5% / 2.1% for our fully trained 22M baseline), lowering its mean error from 1.34 ∘ / 1.84 ∘ to 1.16 ∘ / 1.47 ∘ , at the cost of introducing occasional blank responses between prediction frames. Our results tables do not employ this technique in order to remain comparable to previous methods, which report over the full test sets.
blocks.zh: 对于最初的16级单程车型,我们观察到,在大多数发生灾难性翻转的情况下,该型号的信心很低. 300M型机车显示每帧置信度中位数(它的K K 每键点热映射峰值的平均值)为:正确帧0.90对轻箱域的翻转帧0.39,阳镜域的翻转帧0.88对0.41;840M型机车给出了各自域的0.92对0.31和0.91对0.39. 在包含有和无翻转的误差分解时,我们的300M型机车在所有帧上的平均旋转误差为1.90 ∘ / 2.26 ∘ (灯盒 / sunlamp),但1.51 ∘ / 1.82 ∘ → 仅非翻转帧;840M型机车为1.34 ∘ / 1.84 ∘ / 1.23 ∘ / 1.52 → . 如图3所示,模型一般对翻转的预测给予较低的信心. 300M型的翻转率从0.43%/0.47%降至0.09%/0.07%,其平均旋转误差降至1.46 / 1.81。 840M模型只需截留2%即可在两个领域实现零翻转(从0.13%/0.21%,而我们训练有素的22M基线为1.5%/2.1%), 我们的成绩表没有使用这种技术来保持与以往方法的可比性,因为以往方法报告的是全套测试。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: This paper shows that adapting large self-supervised ViT models such as DINOv3 improves on the results of previous methods that use relatively smaller encoders while holding other architecture elements constant. We find that these large encoders do not perform well when frozen but that modern fine tuning methods like LoRA and DoRA allow for adaptation of a small percent of encoder weights to achieve state of the art capabilities in this domain. This result suggests that future missions that require onboard pose estimation of a target craft, and that have available compute for a model of this size (on the Jetson Orin NX measured here, one network pass in 134–420 ms at 11–32 W of board draw), have a more accurate option than the previous state of the art. Additionally, our rank-16 results show that scaling from 300M to 840M cuts mean rotation error by roughly 15–30% and roughly halves catastrophic flips, suggesting there may still be headroom to improve results further with larger foundation models. Our model was only trained and tested on a single target satellite with a well-defined 3D model and predefined keypoints, a stronger geometric prior than approximate-model methods such as EagerNet require, and limited to predictions from single frames.
blocks.zh: 本文显示,对DINOv3等大型自控ViT模型的改造改进了以往在保持其他架构元素恒定的同时使用相对较小的编码器的方法的结果. 我们发现,这些大型编码器在冷冻时表现不佳,但现代的微调方法,如LORA和DORA, 允许调整一小部分编码器的重量,以实现这个领域的艺术能力。 这个结果表明,今后需要登机的飞行任务对目标飞行器作出估计,并且对这种尺寸的模型(在此测量的Jetson Orin NX上,一个网络以134–420毫秒的速度以11–32W的图纸)有可用的计算,比以前的技术水平更准确的选择。 此外,我们排名16的结果显示,从300M削减到840M削减意味着轮转误差大约15-30%,并且大约将灾难性翻转减半,这表明在更大的基础模式下,可能还有改进结果的首室。 我们的模型只在一颗目标卫星上接受过训练和测试,卫星上有一个定义明确的三维模型和预先确定的键点,比EagerNet等近似模型方法需要的更强几何,并且仅限于单帧的预测.
